name: Bakunyuu Sennyuu Sousakan ~Honnou e no Nikuyoku Kyousoukyoku~
original_name: 爆乳 潜入捜査官 ～本能への肉欲狂奏曲～
source:
Japan in the near future
The idea of prosperous Japan became a myth, and people live in poverty.
People started to rumor about an underground kingdom where vicious crimes are organized exists somewhere in this country.
May from "Special fighting force Snake" started investigating on this.
However, one incident occurred and that was the beginning of her downfall...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081722.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
不久後的日本。

繁榮日本的理念已成神話，人們生活在貧困之中。

人們開始傳說，這個國家某處存在一個組織殘酷犯罪的地下王國。

「蛇」特別戰鬥部隊的梅伊開始調查此事。

然而，一起事件發生了，這成為她墮落的開端……

[來源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081722.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
